ops.title: PR 1316: bind lane evidence before queuing each judge
ops.description: Owner: PR #1316 implementation lane (agentic-judge-landing). Static review only; no tests run. Evidence: desk-runner.py:3811. lanes_gone submits an evidence lambda that closes over the for-loop variables lane, unanswered, posted and naming. When the two judge workers are occupied, the queued reader evaluates after those variables change and judges an earlier lane against another lane's records. A no then permanently silences the wrong alarm. Next executable step: bind the four values per iteration, or freeze the evidence before submission; add a saturated-pool, multi-lane regression in CI.

ops.text: With more candidates than judge workers, every artifact and evidence pair describes the same lane and its own orders and records.
